cohort: 121 mothers who gave birth and received care at a government hospital in an urban area of Brahmapur, Odisha, India
finding: The prevalence of PPD (EPDS score ≥ 12) was 8.26%, with significant correlations found between PPD and maternal age, anemia, mode of delivery, educational status, adverse life events, and lack of partner support.
mod_finding: A higher prevalence of PPD was observed among mothers who underwent a lower segment cesarean section.
